title: Minipurge:Blue
description: Add-on to Minipurge. Generates custom treasure blimps throughout the map.
body:
# 🎈 Minipurge: Blue | Treasure Blimps Add-on

**Take your Minipurge events to the skies!** Minipurge: Blue is an official add-on for the [Minipurge](https://modrinth.com/datapack/minipurge) event framework. This data pack automatically generates custom, floating loot blimps throughout the arena at the beginning of each round. 

These blimps are packed with valuable resources and gear, transforming the sky into high-stakes points of contention. Players will have to decide: is it worth risking the climb to secure top-tier loot, or is it better to wait on the ground and ambush whoever makes it back down?

![Blimps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc8512feacff237401dc008c809effff9a9bdac1_0.webp)

![More Blimps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f17024f3cf074360599370fe1e95fc794bb3dd15_0.webp)

---

## ⚙️ How to Install
1. Make sure you have the core **[Minipurge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/minipurge)** data pack installed in your world.
2. Drop the `Minipurge:Blue` `.zip` file into your world's `datapacks` folder alongside it.
3. That's it! Start your Minipurge event normally, and the data pack will handle the rest.

---
